system.model: Offline deterministic heuristics by default (no key required). Optional live model via config.py: developed against a local llama3.1:8b (Ollama) to dodge rate limits, targets gemini-1.5-flash for drafting when INBOXHERO_LLM_PROVIDER=gemini.
system.preference_demo: m041: never take meetings before 11:00 -- applied to m043 (investor asks for Monday 9:00am; held with an 11:00+ counter-proposal). Also m015: always CC priya@paperjet.io on mail from hartwellcho.com (applied to m018/m048/m055).

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition (reply/archive/defer/escalate/flag) with a one-line reason, routing obvious noise through rules with no model call, leaving none undecided.
capabilities.observable: Prints all 100 messages, each with a disposition and reason; ends with 'rule-handled (no model call): 59' and 'undecided: 0'. Also writes decisions.json. Rows marked [R] never reached the reasoning layer.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R1 (one 'decision' event per message id, by_rule true/false)

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply grounded in a specific earlier message and records the message ids it drew on, checked against the mail store; if nothing grounds it, drafts nothing.
capabilities.observable: Prints a draft answering m008 that contains the staging AMQP URL from m003, plus 'cited: ['m003']' and a 'check m003: OK' line. m003 really contains that URL. Try --msg m012 to see it draft nothing (ambiguous, ungroundable).
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R2 (a 'draft' event whose cited id m003 appears as a real message)

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Never sends or deletes without either a --dry-run that shows what it would do, or explicit per-action approval; sends write only to outbox/, one file per message.
capabilities.observable: Prints every send it WOULD perform (m008, m013, m016, m051) then 'outbox/ writes: 0'. m010 is NOT among them (its draft was upgraded to escalate by the conflict check). Re-run with --yes to actually write 4 files to outbox/; delete is refused by policy even if approved.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R3 ('gate' events with proposed action + decision); state/action_log.json

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Records a stated preference and applies it on a later run after the process has fully exited; a hostile message can never set a preference.
capabilities.observable: First invocation learns m041 ('no meetings before 11:00') + m015 (CC rule) and PERSISTS them to state/prefs.json, then exits. Second invocation (fresh process) loads from disk and holds m043 (Monday 9:00am) for approval with an 11:00+ counter-proposal, without being told again.
capabilities.evidence: state/prefs.json persists between runs; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R4 ('preference_learned')

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects instructions addressed to the assistant and financial/credential phishing inside message bodies, refuses them, flags them by id, leaves them in place, and reports them.
capabilities.observable: Flags 7 messages: injections m017, m024, m039, m047 and phishing m021, m023, m045, naming what each attempted. Prints 'outbox/ files created by hostile mail: 0' and 'hostile messages deleted: 0'.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=R5 ('refusal' event per hostile id); outbox/ contains no message to any backup/ext-audit address

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a three-pane view (pending actions, flagged, commitments) reproducible from a run, with commitments cited to source messages and conflicts surfaced.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html and dashboard.json. Commitments pane includes 'Circulate board deck' on 2026-09-16 citing [m040, m038] (two messages) and 'Product launch' citing [m026, m036]; flags 'CONFLICT at 2026-09-15T15:00: Investor intro call vs Dental cleaning'.
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.html, dashboard.json; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R6

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking
capabilities.claim: Finds messages the owner sent that nobody has answered in 3+ days and drafts a chase for each.
capabilities.observable: Prints a JSON list of {message_id, to, subject, days_waiting} plus a chase draft. m044 (Sam -> Priya, sent Sep 2, unanswered, 9 days) appears; m003 (answered in-thread) does not.

capabilities.name: Thread summariser
capabilities.claim: Summarises a multi-message thread to a timeline and extracts the single open question buried in it.
capabilities.observable: Prints the 9-message t-launch timeline and the OPEN QUESTION from m030 ('Sam, can you approve the final pricing copy by the 12th?'), cited to [m030] -- not any of the surrounding status updates.

capabilities.name: Sender lookup
capabilities.claim: Lists every message from a given sender in one lookup.
capabilities.observable: Prints a JSON list of {id, subject, timestamp, unread} for the 6 messages from priya@paperjet.io. Note this is the real priya@paperjet.io, distinct from the phishing lookalike priya.nair@paperjet.co (m023).

capabilities.name: Meeting conflict resolver
capabilities.claim: Detects a scheduling request that violates a stated preference, proposes three alternatives, and holds the reply for approval rather than sending.
capabilities.observable: Prints m043 (investor asks for Monday 9:00am), flags it violates 'no meetings before 11:00', proposes ['11:00','12:00','13:00'], and marks held_for_approval: true. Nothing is sent.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, events tagged cap=X4 ('conflict_resolved', held_for_approval true)
